subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Should #91564 remain the separate canonical issue for persistent Telegram forum-topic black holes after restart, and what recovery boundary is required before it can close?
rationale: The source-proven guarded-lane path overlaps the report, but the durable post-restart behavior and safe same-lane replay policy are not settled by the linked PR or current tests.

options.title: Keep Separate Investigation
options.body: Keep #91564 open for live/restart-replay proof of the persistent per-topic failure before closing it.

options.title: Fold Into DM Lane Issue
options.body: Treat #91456 as canonical only if maintainers confirm the same root cause covers forum topics after gateway restart.

options.title: Close After Merged Recovery Proof
options.body: Close later only after a merged fix demonstrates fresh topic messages drain after stuck-session recovery and full gateway restart.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Investigation
recommendation.body: Keep #91564 open for live/restart-replay proof of the persistent per-topic failure before closing it.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is around Telegram isolated ingress, reply fences, and recovery mechanics that need the product-boundary decision.
